title: rosa cathayensis
intro: Rosa cathayensis, commonly known as the Chinese rose or wild rose, is a species of flowering plant in the family Rosaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, particularly in traditional Chinese medicine, where it is used to promote relaxation and alleviate various health issues. The health benefits of Rosa cathayensis include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce stress and improve overall well-being. The bioactive constituents of Rosa cathayensis include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as sedative and anti-anxiety effects.
